name: frontend-templates
description: A modular frontend blueprint to kickstart modern web projects. Includes shared base configs and stack-specific branches.

scripts.check:git: git --version && git diff --check && bash -c 'missing=$(git ls-files | git check-attr -a --stdin | grep -E ": text: auto$" || true); if [ -n "$missing" ]; then printf ".gitattributes rule missing:\n%s\n" "$missing" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.format: npm run lint:fix && npm run prettier:write
scripts.lint: npm run lint:formatting && npm run lint:editorconfig && npm run eslint && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:fix: npm run eslint:fix && npm run lint:style:fix && npm run lint:md:fix
scripts.test: npm run check:git && npm run lint && npm run check:copypaste && npm run check:secret && npm run check:spell && npm run check:deps
